quote.text: Everywhere means nowhere. When a person spends all his time in foreign travel, he ends by having many acquaintances, but no friends.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Just as a parent nurtures deep bonds at home, so too must we cultivate genuine relationships rather than scattering our affections across many fleeting encounters.
    • Investing quality time in family helps build trust and understanding, reminding us that depth in connection outweighs the breadth of superficial interactions.
  • Leadership
    • A wise leader knows that true influence comes from close, meaningful relationships, not from empty networks of acquaintances.
    • Fostering a core team with whom one shares trust and responsibility allows for consistency and resilience in navigating challenges.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, success is driven by deep insights from a focused group of users rather than trying to serve everyone superficially.
    • Prioritizing genuine feedback and understanding the core needs of your community can lead to products that resonate and endure, much like true friendships.
